feedback: The test cases directly and unambiguously verify the arithmetic precedence requirement (multiplication and division before addition and subtraction) as specified in the requirement. Test R005-T01 evaluates nested operations with parentheses and mixed precedence, while R005-T02 demonstrates left-to-right evaluation for same-precedence operators. Both cases are mathematically validated by reference checks, confirming correct precedence and order of operations. The tests cover the core intent of the requirement without overreach or ambiguity. Coverage is complete and justified.
